description: Retrieve corpus Patterns whose text resembles the observed behaviours, ranked by retrieval relevance (text similarity, not diagnostic probability). Returns candidates with matched_in and matched_aliases for transparency; it does not judge whether the observations are sufficient to apply any Pattern. The base package uses field-weighted keyword search; the optional embeddings extra adds cosine re-ranking.

modality_hint.description: Optional hint about which modality the observations come from.

observations.description: Observed behaviours, symptoms, or log patterns.

name: differential_diagnosis
